title: Electronic Disclosure by Group Health Plans under Employee Retirement Income Security Act
pass_4_primary_concern: The record leaves meaningful uncertainty about whether the projected electronic-delivery benefits and 90-percent uptake assumption account for access and delivery failures.
pass_5_high_stakes_domain_reason: The rule governs delivery of health-plan disclosures that can affect participants' understanding of coverage and rights.
pass_5_concise_why: The proposal is structurally coherent and contains substantial analysis, with the principal integrity questions concerning access safeguards and benefit assumptions.
pass_5_most_important_consequence: If electronic delivery fails for people with limited access or bad contact information, participants may miss health-plan disclosures despite formal notice and opt-out rights.
